evidence.note: Flat cream paper colour; no texture, grain, grid or hairline rules.
Large dark serif title and green kicker; high contrast, generous size.
Body copy (the slide's only data claim) set in light grey on cream, noticeably faint against the background.
In the small window the two body paragraphs shrink to roughly 15-16 px light grey text; low contrast makes them the first thing compression would blur.
Header breadcrumb and Loans/Notes chips are small, but they are chrome; Notes chip is grey on cream.

rationale: There are no hairlines or texture, and the title is large and high contrast. The body text, which carries the slide's key numbers, is small light grey on cream and gets faint at the small-window size. That matches the fail descriptor of small faint text.
